# RenderBridge - ExtTemplate

This is the README of the template extension ExtTemplate which you can base your own extension on.

The RenderBridge SDK is in a subdirectory, which can be easily updated. It contains:

- `docs` - Documentation of the RX Extension Interface [[Reference.md](RenderBridge/docs/Reference.md), [Reference.html](RenderBridge/docs/Reference.html)].
- `extensions` - Some example extensions.
- `include` - C++ include files of the RX Extension Interface.
- `libs` - Some additional libraries used by the example extensions.
- `RX` - A minimal RX engine for testing the extensions.

## Build Instructions:

- Install [CMake](https://cmake.org/).

- Run any `msvc*.bat` to generate and open a Visual Studio solution.
